keywords_en: net gas metering for account changes
summary_en: pcaversaccio compared the gas to deploy an ERC-20 under Osaka and Amsterdam: EIP-8037 adds 97,920 state gas for 64 SSTOREs, and he questioned why EIP-7997 is in Glamsterdam. Two EIPs from rakita (net gas metering for account changes, and persisting warm access sets across reverts) were merged as drafts. Frame transactions tightened further: checking signer key authority, default code in SENDER mode, and a single price for every data byte. Vitalik considers the zkEVM speed race won and says the focus should shift fully to security.
